title: geocardia repens
intro: Geocardia repens, commonly known as Periwinkle or Vinca major, is a flowering plant in the dogbane family, Apocynaceae. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing blood pressure, improving digestion, and providing antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Geocardia repens include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects, making it useful for treating various conditions such as anxiety, insomnia, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, particularly vinblastine and vincristine, which are used in cancer chemotherapy, as well as other compounds like apigenin and luteolin, which exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
